def stats_of(p):
    # for node p: orbit length L, cycle start s, cycle length c
    L=np.zeros(N,int); S=np.zeros(N,int); Cy=np.zeros(N,int)
    for n in range(N):
        seq=[p]; cur=p
        while True:
            cur=X[n,cur]
            if cur in seq: break
            seq.append(cur)
        s=seq.index(cur); L[n]=len(seq); S[n]=s; Cy[n]=len(seq)-s
    return L,S,Cy
cands={}
for p in range(5):
    L,S,Cy = stats_of(p)
    cands[f'c{p}']=Cy; cands[f'L{p}']=L; cands[f's{p}']=S
for k,v in cands.items():
    a=(np.minimum(v,4)-1==dec).mean()
    b=(v==dec).mean()
    if a>0.9 or b>0.9: print(k, round(a,4), round(b,4))
print('--- base c4', (np.minimum(cands['c4'],4)-1==dec).mean())

img=np.array([len(set(X[n])) for n in range(N)])

def fwd(E,B0,M0,B1,M1,WU,ret_sites=False):
    # E [N,5,6]
    S0=np.einsum('nid,de,nje->nij',E,B0,E)/np.sqrt(6)
    p0=np.exp(S0-S0.max(-1,keepdims=True)); p0/=p0.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
    a0=np.einsum('nij,nje->nie',p0,np.einsum('nid,de->nie',E,M0))
    r0=E+a0
    S1=np.einsum('nid,de,nje->nij',r0,B1,r0)/np.sqrt(6)

    a1=np.einsum('nij,nje->nie',p1,np.einsum('nid,de->nie',r0,M1))
    r1=r0+a1
    o=r1[:,4]@WU
    if ret_sites: return o,(p0,a0,r0,p1,a1,r1)
    return o

def fwd_np(E,B0,M0,B1,M1,WU):
    S0=np.einsum('nid,de,nje->nij',E,B0,E)/np.sqrt(6)
    p0=np.exp(S0-S0.max(-1,keepdims=True)); p0/=p0.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
    a0=np.einsum('nij,nje->nie',p0,np.einsum('nid,de->nie',E,M0))
    r0=E+a0
    S1=np.einsum('nid,de,nje->nij',r0,B1,r0)/np.sqrt(6)
    p1=np.exp(S1-S1.max(-1,keepdims=True)); p1/=p1.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
    a1=np.einsum('nij,nje->nie',p1,np.einsum('nid,de->nie',r0,M1))
    return (r0+a1)[:,4]@WU

def ifmt(M,name,sc=1000):
    A=np.round(np.array(M)*sc).astype(int)
    if A.ndim==1: A=A[None,:]
    return name+' = np.array(['+','.join('['+','.join(str(v) for v in r)+']' for r in A)+'])*SC\n'

Coefficients are measured; the token embedding is exactly the one-hot basis, so no token table is needed."
SC=0.001

def sm(s):
    s=s-s.max(-1,keepdims=True); e=np.exp(s); return e/e.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
def model(x, iv):
    B=x.shape[0]; P=x.shape[1]
    oh=(x[...,None]==np.arange(5)).astype(float)
    E=np.concatenate([oh+WP[None,:P,:5], np.broadcast_to(WP[None,:P,5:],(B,P,1))],-1)
    E=iv('embed',E.reshape(B,-1)).reshape(B,P,6)
    p0=iv('pattern0',sm(np.einsum('bid,de,bje->bij',E,B0,E)/np.sqrt(6)).reshape(B,-1)).reshape(B,P,P)
    a0=iv('attn_out0',np.einsum('bij,bje->bie',p0,E@M0).reshape(B,-1)).reshape(B,P,6)
    r0=iv('resid_mid0',(E+a0).reshape(B,-1)).reshape(B,P,6)
    p1=sm(np.einsum('bid,de,bje->bij',r0,B1,r0)/np.sqrt(6))
    r1=iv('resid_mid1',(r0+np.einsum('bij,bje->bie',p1,r0@M1)).reshape(B,-1)).reshape(B,P,6)
    return r1[:,4]@WU
ALIGN={'embed':['embed'],'pattern0':['attn0.pattern'],'attn_out0':['attn0.out'],'resid_mid0':['resid0.mid'],'resid_mid1':['resid1.mid']}
'''

import numpy as np
def sm(s):
    s=s-s.max(-1,keepdims=True); e=np.exp(s); return e/e.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
def fwd(tok, WP=WP,B0=B0,M0=M0,B1=B1,M1=M1,WU=WUg):
    B,P_=tok.shape
    oh=(tok[...,None]==np.arange(5)).astype(float)
    E=np.concatenate([oh+WP[None,:P_,:5], np.broadcast_to(WP[None,:P_,5:],(B,P_,1))],-1)
    p0=sm(np.einsum('bid,de,bje->bij',E,B0,E)/np.sqrt(6))
    r0=E+np.einsum('bij,bje->bie',p0,E@M0)
    p1=sm(np.einsum('bid,de,bje->bij',r0,B1,r0)/np.sqrt(6))
    r1=r0+np.einsum('bij,bje->bie',p1,r0@M1)
    return r1[:,4]@WU, (E,p0,r0,p1,r1)
